title: Rule-Breaking Animals Part 1: The Pistol Shrimp
hook: Part one: This tiny creature punches water hard enough to make it glow.
script: Part one: This tiny creature punches water hard enough to make it glow. How does the pistol shrimp generate heat rivaling the surface of the sun? Its snapping claw fires a water jet that creates a rapidly collapsing cavitation bubble. When that bubble implodes, temperatures reach nearly four thousand seven hundred degrees. The resulting shockwave is so intense that ocean colonies disrupt military submarine sonar. If the main claw breaks off, its other small claw transforms into the weapon. Would you ever keep one in an aquarium? Follow for part two.
